The '''Ringo Vinda space station'''<ref name="Concept Art Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-unknown-concept-art-gallery|text="The Unknown" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref> was a ring-shaped<ref name="Ringo Vinda" /> civilian [[Shipyard|graving dock]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> that [[Orbit|encircled]] the [[planet]] [[Ringo Vinda]]. Controlled by the [[Galactic Republic]], it was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Ringo Vinda" /> This resulted in the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda]],<ref name="Clone Commander Doom">{{Databank|clone-commander-doom|Clone Commander Doom}}</ref> a Republic<ref name="Ringo Vinda" /> campaign<ref name="Episode Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/conspiracy-episode-gallery|text="Conspiracy" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 13}}</ref> launched in the [[Standard year|year]] [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> in a bid to retake the station from the Separatists.<ref name="Ringo Vinda" /> After the war, it was converted into a construction facility by the [[Galactic Empire]] to churn out [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class]] [[Star Destroyer]]s for the [[Imperial Navy]],<ref name="ROUVG" /> and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[agent]]s reported to [[General]] [[Airen Cracken]] about the industrial status of the station.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> The station had a command center and a communications center during the Clone Wars.<ref name="The Unknown" />

{{Station-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ringo Vinda space station first appeared in "[[The Unknown]],"<ref name="The Unknown" /> the first episode of the [[canon]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]],<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-unknown-episode-guide|text="The Unknown" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> which originally aired in [[Wikipedia:Germany|Germany]] on [[February 15]], [[2014]].<ref name="Jedi News">{{WebCite|url=http://www.jedinews.co.uk/misc/articles/star-wars-the-clone-wars-season-six-launching-15th-february-in-germany|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Season Six Launching 15th February In Germany|author=Mark Newbold|date=2014-01-16, 11:31 AM, BST|work=[http://www.jedinews.co.uk Jedi News]|archivedate=20170425214828}}</ref><ref name="German TV Schedule">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fernsehserien.de/star-wars-the-clone-wars/folgen/6x01-zustand-unbekannt-583331|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars S06E01: Zustand unbekannt (State Unknown)|work=[https://www.fernsehserien.de fernsehserian.de]|language=[[Wikipedia:German|German]]|archivedate=20250814170545}}</ref>
